import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')
plt.figure()
plt.hist(df['temp_c'].dropna())
plt.xlabel('Temperature (°C)')
plt.ylabel('Frequency')
plt.title('Histogram of Temperature Values')
